local_patches.summary: v5.5/v5.6 field fixes (#414) applied to the vendored bundle in place, pending upstreaming — the shipped tableau.mjs is source_commit plus the changes below.
changes: multi-datasource merge: dedupe merged controls by controlId before display name — two child datasources can emit controls with different names but the same param-derived controlId, which the name-only key let through and the DM POST rejected as duplicate ids

multi-datasource merge: child conversions (options.__multiDsChild) no longer call resetIds() — children continue the monotonic element-id counter so the merged dm-spec stays duplicate-free; top-level single-datasource conversions keep the reset for corpus id determinism

no default warehouse db/schema: new warehouseDbSchemaFromConn() derives database/schema from the workbook's own warehouse <connection> attrs (non-warehouse classes and file-path/.hyper dbnames skipped) when no --database/--schema override is passed; the root relation and each side of a blend fall back to their own connection instead of a fabricated default

calc flexibility: federated-join cross-table coalesce synthesis — IFNULL/ZN/IF-ISNULL cross-table fallback calcs are rewritten to Coalesce(local, Lookup(target column, join keys)); join-key collection walks AND-wrapped equality clauses so every key pair is kept (leftKeys/rightKeys), not just the first top-level '='
calc flexibility: bare-ref case-fold — case- and underscore-normalized display-name indexes so bare column references resolve across tables regardless of casing

calc flexibility: parameter member aliases captured (memberAliases value->alias) and emitted as the manual-list control's labels[] — values stay the codes translated calcs compare against; labels only change the rendered option text
comment-only hygiene neutralization of a workbook name in the multi-datasource comment (no behavior change)

local_patches.commit: worktree (uncommitted at patch time — becomes the landing commit of the PR #508 calc-hotfix batch)
local_patches.summary: Calc-translation hotfixes (PR #508 speed-program batch, live-verified bugs) applied to the vendored bundle in place AND to the local vendor source tree (scripts/vendor/sigma-data-model-mcp src/formulas.ts + rebuilt build/ + updated src tests), pending upstreaming. Fallback path used deliberately: the local upstream clone does not contain source_commit d769bec (divergent history, dirty src/tableau.ts) and re-bundling from any source tree would drop the unlanded d8a049a bundle-only patches above.
changes: ZN → native Sigma Zn() via TABLEAU_FUNC_MAP name-map; removed the single-paren Coalesce($1, 0) regex that emitted malformed Coalesce(Sum([x], 0)) for ZN(AGG(...)) — the dominant field null-guard idiom

removed Coalesce from _TEXT_FN_RE: its type follows its args, and counting it as text-producing turned numeric ZN(a)+ZN(b) addition into silent string concat (&); _isTextOperand instead recurses into Coalesce's top-level args, so string-literal guard chains (Coalesce([a], "x") + …) still convert + to & while numeric or unknown-type guards keep +

start-of-week literal handling: DATETRUNC 3rd arg / 4-arg DATEDIFF 'monday' is still dropped (Sigma has no start-of-week slot) but now emits a verify warning instead of silent week-boundary drift; the drop is scoped to DateTrunc/DateDiff via a balanced-paren walk so other calls keeping a weekday string as a real last argument (e.g. CONTAINS(x, 'monday')) are no longer mangled

stopped emitting non-existent Sigma functions: DATETIME → Date (was Datetime), DATEPART('weekday'/'dayofweek') → Weekday(date) with a numbering-verify warning (was DayOfWeek), DATENAME('week') → Text(DatePart("week", …)) at the source branch (was Text(Week(…)))

un-staled the window-untranslatable list: WINDOW_CORR/WINDOW_VAR/WINDOW_COUNT now map to MovingCorr/MovingVariance/MovingCount (offset forms spanning the current row; all three present in the Sigma function index, verified 2026-07-25); population variants WINDOW_VARP/COVARP/STDEVP stay untranslatable; SIGMA_CHART_ONLY_WINDOW_RE extended with MovingVariance/MovingCorr so the DM router keeps refusing them

local_patches.commit: worktree (uncommitted at patch time — becomes the W2.16 landing commit on wave/2-conv)
local_patches.summary: W2.16 union emission + named-refusal stopgap applied to the vendored bundle in place, pending upstreaming (same fallback path as the entries above: the local upstream clone's history is divergent from source_commit d769bec and re-bundling would drop the unlanded bundle-only patches). Paired Ruby-side change in the same commit: scan-workbook-gaps.rb detect_unions emits the hint/❌ union rows whose derivability test mirrors this emission.
changes: union root relations (relType 'union') now CONVERT instead of silently emitting nothing: root-level same-connection wildcard unions (>=2 derivable member tables + >=1 metadata output column, Sheet/'Table Name' bookkeeping columns excluded) emit one warehouse-table element per member plus an elementId-sourced union element, per sigma-data-models reference/sources.md 'Union' — elementId-based sources (direct warehouse-table union sources fail on special-char columns), NO name on the union element (an explicit name breaks self-referential column validation; the API auto-names it 'Union of N Sources' and column formulas use that prefix), matches[].sourceColumns as bracketed friendly names resolved in each member's own column set (member columns carry explicit name to pin resolution)

member elements are pushed FIRST and the union element LAST so last-writer-wins display-name resolution lands every column on the union element; factEl selection gains a union preference (relationships > union source > max-columns) so translated calcs and auto-metrics attach to the stacked rows, not one member

underivable unions (root with <2 derivable members or 0 metadata columns; unions nested in a join tree never reach the branch) fall to a LOUD named refusal warning with the derived counts and the Custom SQL UNION ALL / re-point escalation route — NO elements emitted, silent loss dead

unsupported datasource root relation types now emit a named 'NOT supported — NO ELEMENTS EMITTED' warning listing the supported set (table, join, collection, text, union) instead of falling through silently

local_patches.commit: worktree (uncommitted at patch time — becomes the W2.17 landing commit on wave/2-conv)
local_patches.summary: W2.17 true parameter defaults applied to the vendored bundle in place, pending upstreaming (upstream source anchor: src/tableau.ts:4089-4090 hardcoded control shapes = the bundle's parameter-control emission loop). Every parameter control branch now honors the workbook's own current value; every branch falls back to its exact old shape when the .twb carries none.
changes: parameter default derivation: the .twb's current value attr wins (date literals #...# unwrapped), else the initial-value calc when it is a plain literal (quoted string with escape handling, date literal, bare number/boolean) — never an expression
list-domain params: the default becomes values:[default] when it is a domain member (labels/aliases preserved); non-member or absent -> values:[] unchanged

date/datetime params with a literal date default: the date-range last-90 hardcode is replaced by controlType 'date', mode '=', ISO value (datetime keeps HH:MM[:SS] via the T separator); no derivable literal -> the old date-range last-90 shape + 'adjust in Sigma UI' warning, unchanged

integer/real non-range params with a finite numeric default: the valueless number-range is replaced by controlType 'number', mode '=', numeric value (includeNulls when-no-value-is-selected); range-domain params KEEP number-range (a single-value default cannot express a range) with the current value noted in the warning

text params: the control gains value:<default> only when present; warnings for every applied default name the source ('from the workbook's current value') so parity readouts show where values came from

_upstream_and_revendor_tasks: Standing vendoring rule: patch upstream and re-vendor; never edit the vendored .mjs in place. When an in-place patch is unavoidable, it lands with its own local_patches entry (commit, summary, upstream_pr) in this file — the hygiene.yml converter-provenance guard rejects any plugins/**/converter/*.mjs diff whose range does not also change the sibling PROVENANCE.json.
TASK 1 — upstream: port each open local_patches entry to source_repo's tableau converter source, one reviewable PR per functional change; set the entry's upstream_pr field when the PR opens.

TASK 2 — re-vendor: after the upstream PR merges, run tools/vendor-converters.sh <checkout> tableau; the source_commit/source_commit_date bump and regeneration of this file are what retire landed local_patches entries.

TASK 3 — guard the unlanded: BOTH regenerators rewrite this file wholesale — tools/vendor-converters.sh (the canonical path) AND the skill-local scripts/dev/vendor-converter.sh (whose header still says to re-run it after converter changes, and which writes a stale schema with no local_patches at all) — so regenerating while any local_patches entry is still open silently drops that patch record; either wait, or re-apply the patch and re-record local_patches (and this task block) in the same commit. Refresh only via tools/vendor-converters.sh.
TASK 4 — prove parity: after any re-vendor, corpus/run-corpus.sh --check and corpus/converter-default-test.sh must stay green before a retirement counts as done.
